title: Land at Haneda · wagyu all-you-can-eat welcome feast · Round1 bowling & karaoke · Mutekiya ramen

stops.name: Arrive Haneda Airport T3
stops.plan: Land 15:00; immigration and bags, then load Suica/PASMO IC cards for all 8 at the Keikyu ticket machines.
stops.transport: Keikyu Airport line to Shinagawa, JR Yamanote line to Ikebukuro, Seibu Ikebukuro line to Higashi-Nagasaki, then walk (about 60–70 min)

stops.name: Check in Ninja House
stops.plan: Check in (from 16:00), drop all the luggage, quick freshen-up.
stops.transport: Walk to Higashi-Nagasaki, Seibu Ikebukuro line to Ikebukuro, walk to the East exit (about 36 min)

stops.name: Kingyuen (wagyu all-you-can-eat yakiniku)
stops.plan: Booked private room for 8: wagyu all-you-can-eat course with the all-you-can-drink add-on, the welcome feast.

stops.name: Round1 Ikebukuro
stops.plan: Two bowling lanes of 4 or a big karaoke room, plus the arcade floor. Bring original passports for the night ID check.
stops.price: Pay at the counter (late-night packs vary)

stops.name: Mutekiya
stops.plan: Late tonkotsu ramen to close night one; counter only, so you sit in 2s and 3s. Cash only.
stops.transport: Seibu Ikebukuro line Ikebukuro → Higashi-Nagasaki, then walk (12 min); taxi if you miss the last train

stops.name: Back at Ninja House
stops.plan: Sleep off the jet lag; tomorrow starts about 08:00.
